description: This file defines the SecurityValidations class, which provides validation methods for financial security parameters such as issue date, security period, and redemption value. It extends the FinancialValidations class and utilizes external classes for exceptions and error handling within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: SecurityValidations
classes.description: A class providing static methods for validating various security-related financial parameters such as issue dates, periods, and redemption amounts.

methods.name: validateIssueDate
methods.description: Validates and returns the issue date, ensuring it is a valid date value.

methods.name: validateSecurityPeriod
methods.description: Validates that the settlement date is earlier than the maturity date; throws an exception if invalid.

methods.name: validateRedemption
methods.description: Validates the redemption amount to ensure it is a positive float; throws an exception otherwise.
